text:
marta_ml: FYI ran v4-int4-lite as a 1% canary + shadow. Global numbers look OK but a scoped "longform-instruction" slice (>=3k tokens) shows repeated small regressions. Need quick gate decision.

devon_oncall: How big is "small"? Single snapshot noise?

marta_ml: Snapshot stats: samples=620, rougeL_delta=-0.035, p=0.029, mrr_delta=-0.018. Last two snapshots: -0.015, -0.035. Not huge but consistent trend. Latency and error-rate unchanged.

ria_prod: Product impact: those customers use long-generation pipelines. If this slips after ramp it's a big UX hit. Can we require heavier slice weighting or a hard stop on critical slices?

qc-bot: QC policy reminder: critical slices (safety, longform-instruction) must not have delta <= -0.03 at 1% canary OR require expanded sample retest.

marta_ml: Proposal: add a slice-level hold: if longform-instruction delta <= -0.03 OR p < 0.05 then automatically hold promotion and run expanded long-sample (x2) with deterministic seeds. Auto-rollback: if expanded run still fails -> swap to baseline.

devon_oncall: Also recommend a phased ramp: 1% -> 5% -> 20% with 12h windows and a deterministic smokecheck of 200 seeded long prompts at each step. Block next step on smokecheck failure.

eval-bot: Eval run 4501234567-v4-int4-lite: longform-instruction samples=620, rougeL_delta=-0.035, p=0.029, global_composite=-0.007. Details: internal link.

ria_prod: OK hold. Please post top 10 diffs and open a rollout audit entry so PMs and legal can review the examples. Also add a brief customer impact note for release notes.

marta_ml: Will upload diffs and start expanded run. Opening PR with gate tweak and audit note now. Tagging @ria_prod for review when uploaded.

devon_oncall: I'll wire the alert: on auto-rollback, open an incident in #incidents and DM oncall for 30m with samples and repro notebook.

marta_ml: Thanks. Attaching small repro notebook and seed list in the PR in a few mins.
